integrity: The mathematical argument and reproducibility script are original summaries and checks; no third-party papers or unattributed extracted source text are included. Computation is independently reproducible but does not itself certify the all-real theorem.
scientific_limitations: The theorem evaluates only triangular generic plane-section probability through the original tetrahedron centroid, with all four fractions in (0,1/2). Its limit is not the law of random affine-offset planes. Independent mathematical validation and definitive historical priority have not been established. Exact probability comes from spherical geometry, not Monte Carlo.
title: Sharp triangular-section phase law for independently truncated tetrahedra
